name: Bright Data
one_liner: Web data platform that turns websites into structured data via scrapers, SERP, unblocking and browser APIs.
auth_notes: API key/token sent as Bearer in the Authorization header; a default key is created at signup and more can be added in Account settings with permission levels and expiry. Native access uses proxy username/password.
access_notes: Self-serve signup with a free 5,000 monthly credit tier and no card; default API key is created automatically on account creation. Heavier products (residential proxies) may require KYC.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free tier and automatic API key, documented REST API with bearer auth, official SDKs and MCP server. Docs index shows hundreds of API reference pages. Rate limits not verified.

identity.quote: Web Scraper API Pricing Easily extract web data with our powerful Web Scraper API.

auth.quote: API Access - Authenticate and interact with the Bright Data platform using an API key/token.
Native Access - Authenticate and interact with the Bright Data platform using proxy protocol username and password.
